run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T07:53:54Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is explained by a broken rollout of the checkout service. The only checkout pod (checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68, Pending) cannot start because the checkout Deployment's pod-template image is the corrupted string "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0", which the kubelet rejects with InvalidImageName (invalid reference format); the Deployment has 1 replica and no ready replicas, and the checkout Service endpoints contain only notReadyAddresses. At the same time frontend-proxy's own error spans on operations ingress and router frontend egress rose from 0-7.2 per 21m (0.0-0.15% of ingress spans, present since at least 07:34) to 369-374 per 21m (5.6-6.1%) from ~07:56, and its logs show POST /api/checkout returning 500 via_upstream while /api/cart, /api/products, /api/data and /api/recommendations returned 200/308. The frontend's own error spans are confined to the checkout path (POST /api/checkout, executing api route /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, tcp.connect), rising from 0% to ~5.2-5.5% of frontend spans. A trace from 07:41:57 shows that same /api/checkout path succeeding through checkout (HTTP 200, rpc.grpc.status_code 0) before the rollout, and shows the frontend PlaceOrder span as parent of the checkout PlaceOrder span. A separate, low-rate, pre-existing pattern of 503 "UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}" from frontend-proxy exists from at least 07:34:30 and is treated as background, not as this cause.

claims.text: frontend-proxy's own error spans (span_name=ingress and span_name=router frontend egress, status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR) rose from 0-7.17 spans per 21m at the 07:34:54-07:54:54 evaluation points to 79.4 (07:56:54), 173 (07:58:54), 248.9 (08:00:54) and 369-374 per 21m from ~08:04 onward, while its UNSET-status traffic stayed at ~8,256-14,815 spans per 21m.

In 2-minute windows the frontend-proxy ingress error count was 0-5.33 spans until 07:54, 1.33 at 07:55, then 50.67 at 07:56, 94.67-122.67 thereafter; the ingress error ratio was 0-0.147% for 07:35-07:54, 1.13% at 07:56, 4.68% at 07:59 and 5.59-6.11% from 08:00 to 08:08.

frontend-proxy logs at 08:02:46-08:02:47 show "POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream, while POST /api/cart, GET /api/products/*, GET /api/data and GET /api/recommendations in the same seconds returned 200 or 308.

frontend's own error spans are exclusively on the checkout path: POST /api/checkout (223.3 then 166.0 per 5m), executing api route (pages) /api/checkout (same counts), grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (same counts) and tcp.connect (16.7 then 4.3 per 5m), while GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, GET /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, CartService/AddItem and AdService/GetAds error counts remained 0; the frontend span error ratio rose from 0% to 5.5446% and 5.1822%.

The otel-demo checkout Deployment's pod-template container image is the corrupted value "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0" (contains an embedded newline); the Deployment has replicas=1 with ready and available both absent, while every other otel-demo Deployment (accounting, ad, cart, currency, email, flagd, fraud-detection, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, kafka, load-generator, otel-collector, payment, postgresql, product-catalog, quote, recommendation, shipping, valkey-cart) reports ready=1 and available=1.

The only checkout pod, checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 (created 2026-11-17T07:54:11Z, owner ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99, node i-01ae77f852632de24), is Pending with Ready=False/ContainersNotReady because its checkout container is waiting with reason InvalidImageName and message "Failed to apply default image tag \"quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\\n:1.0.0\": couldn't parse image name ...: invalid reference format"; restartCount is 0 and the container never started.

Kubernetes events for otel-demo record Deployment checkout ScalingReplicaSet (scaled new ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99 up from 0 to 1 at 07:54:11, scaled old checkout-5dccddf8bb down 1→0 at 07:54:04), ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99 SuccessfulCreate of pod checkout-d75b77f99-5mcsx and checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68, old pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-xq5bq Killing at 07:54:04, and Pod InspectFailed/Failed with "Error: InvalidImageName" (counts 27 and 12 on checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68).

ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (created 07:15:56, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout) is scaled to 0 desired, while the new ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99 (created 07:54:01) carries the corrupt image "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0" with 1 desired replica and no ready replicas.

The checkout Service has only notReadyAddresses (pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68, IP 100.96.4.211), i.e. no ready backend, whereas ad, cart, currency, email, flagd, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, kafka, load-generator, otel-collector, payment, postgresql, product-catalog, quote, recommendation, shipping and valkey-cart all list ready addresses.

Before the rollout the checkout path worked: spans at 2026-11-17T07:41:56-07:41:57 show frontend POST /api/checkout with http.status_code 200, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout 200, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with rpc.grpc.status_code 0, and the checkout service span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (rpc.grpc.status_code 0) as a child of the frontend PlaceOrder client span, with its own HTTP POST child span.

Error spans were observed only for accounting 0, cart 0, payment 0, ad 1.03-2.05 (flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream), recommendation 1.03-2.08 (/flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream) and fraud-detection 0-1.05 (flagd EventStream) per 21m in the window, versus frontend-proxy 420-740 and frontend 838.98-1480.99 per 21m from the 07:59:54 evaluation point onward.
frontend-proxy and frontend pods were Running and ready with restartCount 0 at query time; only checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 was Pending among otel-demo pods.

A low-rate, pre-existing pattern of 503s from frontend-proxy with response flag "UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}" on GET /api/products/*, GET /api/cart and GET /api/recommendations is logged at 07:34:30, 07:39:24, 07:41:26, 07:41:27, 07:42:31, 07:42:45, 07:52:48, 07:59:16 and 07:59:33; matching spans at 07:41:26-07:41:27 show ingress http.status_code 503 with router frontend egress http.status_code 0, i.e. no response from the frontend upstream.

Both data-recorders pods (jaeger-traces-recorder-0 created 07:40:42, prometheus-alert-recorder-0 created 07:39:57) are Running on node i-01ae77f852632de24 with restartCount 0, so the data-recorders FailedScheduling/Provisioning/WaitForFirstConsumer events in the window reflect that startup and are not a failing workload.

frontend-proxy is not globally broken: its pod is Running/ready with 0 restarts, and its logs show 200/308 for POST /api/cart, GET /api/products/*, GET /api/data and GET /api/recommendations in the same seconds that POST /api/checkout returned 500; frontend likewise kept serving cart/product/data routes with zero error spans (GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, GET /api/data, CartService/GetCart, CartService/AddItem, AdService/GetAds all 0 errors).

Rejected: a node-level problem on i-01ae77f852632de24. The failing pod was scheduled successfully there, and frontend, frontend-proxy, product-catalog, payment and other pods on the same node expose ready addresses and are Running with 0 restarts.

The sporadic frontend-proxy 503s with "upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}" coming from the frontend upstream may be a second, independent contributor to frontend-proxy's error rate (and could be what drove an "above 0" condition before the checkout rollout, since the first logged occurrence at 07:52:48 is close to the alert start 07:53:54); the evidence shows frontend-triggered connection resets but identifies no faulty object or configuration behind them, and their rate (0.0-0.147% of ingress spans) is far below the post-rollout 5.6-6.1%.

The alert's StartsAt (07:53:54) precedes the first checkout failure evidence (new pod scheduled 07:54:01, created 07:54:11; error-rate jump between the 07:55 and 07:56 evaluation points), so either an Alertmanager/Prometheus evaluation window on data not exposed by these tools, or a different component of the alert expression, set the alert time; the alert's reported value 2.0444 spans/s cannot be reproduced from the trace-derived error series examined here.

Correct the checkout Deployment pod template to a valid image (the previous ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb used ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout) and remove the embedded newline in the image reference, then confirm the checkout pod becomes Ready and the checkout Service endpoint gets a ready address (currently only notReadyAddresses).

Trace the change that produced Deployment checkout generation 4 / revision 2 (image with a literal newline) through the change-history source, which is not integrated in this Run, and consider an admission check that rejects image references that fail reference-format validation.

gaps: Prometheus returned no alerting rules at all (list_prometheus_rules returned an empty, no_data result for rule_name=RequestErrorRate and for the unfiltered query), so the RequestErrorRate expression, its threshold and the reported "current: 2.0444444444444443" cannot be verified, and the instant/evaluation window that made it fire is unknown.

Jaeger returned spans only up to 2026-11-17T07:41:57 for searches of frontend and checkout whose windows extended to 08:14:50, so no failing trace inside 07:54-08:14 could be inspected; the exact frontend error detail for grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder during the outage is unknown.
fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-pr589 returned no lines (no_data) in both filtered and unfiltered queries, so the frontend application's own error text was not readable.

The checkout container never started (InvalidImageName), so there are no checkout application logs; and the 4 MiB log read limit truncated the frontend-proxy 07:00-07:54 query after 07:52:51, leaving later lines in that specific query unread.

kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready and other kube-state-metrics lookups for the checkout Deployment returned no series in this Prometheus, so the exact moment checkout ready replicas went from 1 to 0 could not be read from metrics.
The change-history integration is not available in this Run, so who or what applied the invalid checkout image (Deployment generation 4, revision 2) could not be identified.

Hypothesis H1 (sporadic frontend-initiated 503 connection resets) remains unattributed: no evidence identifies a faulty object, configuration or dependency behind the "upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}" responses.
Consequences beyond the frontend-proxy/frontend/checkout path (for example, any customer-visible outcome outside these telemetry signals) were not measured and remain unverified.
next_steps: Revert or patch the otel-demo checkout Deployment image to a valid reference (ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout as used by ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb) and verify a Ready pod plus a ready checkout Service endpoint.

Identify the source of Deployment checkout generation 4 / revision 2 in the change pipeline, since the placeholder image string contained a literal newline ("quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0").
Add image-reference validation (admission policy or CI check) so a reference that fails format validation cannot reach a Deployment pod template.

Separately investigate the intermittent frontend connection resets that produce frontend-proxy 503 "upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}" responses, independent of this rollout.
